data.body: **[P2] Clean up factory results rejected for a type mismatch.** `_create_plugin` raises before appending an instance whose concrete type differs from `provider.plugin_type`, so the outer error handler never calls that instance's `on_registration_result(False)`. Any constructor-installed filter or global resource therefore survives the failed registration. Retain the returned object long enough to notify it before raising, and add a wrong-type factory regression test with constructor-owned resources.
